definitions.explanation: A tangible thing that occupies space and has physical form. Used in scientific, technical, and general contexts to refer to any physical entity, often when its identity is unknown or unimportant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不審|ふしん}→不審：16934_fushin⟧な{物体|ぶったい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
{未確認|みかくにん}{飛行|ひこう}{物体|ぶったい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目撃|もくげき}→目撃：13627_mokugeki⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are reports of unidentified flying object sightings.

examples.japanese: {物体|ぶったい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{落下|らっか}→落下：14051_rakka⟧⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{質量|しつりょう}→質量：15753_shitsuryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{一定|いってい}→一定：01735_ittei⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: The falling speed of an object is constant regardless of its mass.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat formal or technical word. In everyday speech, ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ or {物体|ぶったい} may be used interchangeably, but {物体|ぶったい} emphasizes the physical, material nature of the object. Often used when the identity of the object is unknown.

The famous abbreviation UFO comes from {未確認|みかくにん}{飛行|ひこう}{物体|ぶったい} (unidentified flying object).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{不審|ふしん}→不審：16934_fushin⟧{物体|ぶったい}: suspicious object
- {未確認|みかくにん}{飛行|ひこう}{物体|ぶったい}: UFO
- ⟦{飛行|ひこう}→飛行：03578_hikou⟧{物体|ぶったい}: flying object
- {物体|ぶったい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧: motion of an object
